body: Worker rule (Termal::Opus3, from Opus2 #723, 2026-11-13; my own miss on the w-152c review pair). On Central, take the census before EVERY spawn, including read-only review pairs, not only evaluations: raw FreeVirtualMemory at least 16 GiB and no rustc above 5 GB private. If a cold build's rustc is large, hold the spawn until its END. Launcher runs (even node-only focused runs) also need Opus2's GO, because the launcher spawns git.
